description: Famulor lets users inspect existing AI assistant configurations, saved versions, available models, languages, voices, and past conversation history in their authenticated workspace. This read-only directory profile cannot create or change assistants, start calls, send messages, launch campaigns, purchase phone numbers, or open billing flows.
